notes: In hospitalityKnowledge.js these entries use drinkType 'hot' (which covers coffee/espresso/cappuccino/irish coffee-type hot drinks generically, not a distinct 'coffee' tag) -- captured here as drinkType: 'hot' to stay faithful to the source condition.
conditions objects are literal restatements of RULES[].match(d, w) from hospitalityKnowledge.js, where d = dish.tags and w = drink.tags.
phrases.*.text values are copied verbatim from RULES[].clauses[tone].
'hot-dessert' is also cross-referenced (duplicated) in dessert_pairings.json since it is gated on d.course === 'DESSERT'; that duplication is intentional per the requested file split, not an error.

aiService.js's 'Sweet finish pairing' rule (dessert -> irish coffee/espresso/whisky/cognac) DOES include hot-drink keywords (irish coffee, espresso), but per the task instructions that entire aiService rule is filed under dessert_pairings.json only, not duplicated here.
